outcome: fetal brain remodeling (smaller cerebellum, lower corpus callosum area, delayed cortical maturation)
fetal brain injury (higher amniotic fluid neuron-specific enolase, protein S100B, and glial fibrillary acidic protein concentrations)
cohort: Singleton pregnant patients with preterm labor with intact membranes or preterm premature rupture of membranes between 24.0 and 34.0 weeks of gestation, alongside gestational age-matched controls without these conditions.
finding: Fetuses from mothers with preterm labor with intact membranes or preterm premature rupture of membranes showed prenatal signs of brain remodeling and injury at the time of clinical presentation, with these changes being more pronounced in fetuses with intra-amniotic inflammation.
cross-section timing: Observations were taken prenatally between 24.0 and 34.0 weeks of gestation at the time of clinical presentation.
